mapper.sql: s.PARKING_SPACE_ID AS "parkingSpaceId", f.FLOOR_NO AS "floorNo", f.FLOOR_NAME AS "floorName", z.ZONE_CODE AS "zoneCode", s.SPACE_NUMBER AS "spaceNumber", s.SPACE_TYPE_CODE AS "spaceTypeCode", s.SPACE_STATUS_CODE AS "spaceStatusCode", s.X_POSITION AS "xPosition", s.Y_POSITION AS "yPosition", s.WIDTH AS "width", s.HEIGHT AS "height", (TO_CHAR(f.FLOOR_NO) || 'F-' || z.ZONE_CODE || s.SPACE_NUMBER) AS "spaceCode", TO_CHAR(s.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PARKING_SPACE s JOIN PARKING_ZONE z ON z.PARKING_ZONE_ID = s.PARKING_ZONE_ID JOIN PARKING_FLOOR f ON f.PARKING_FLOOR_ID = z.PARKING_FLOOR_ID ORDER BY f.FLOOR_NO, z.ZONE_CODE, s.SPACE_NUMBER

SELECT , s.MEMO AS "memo", CASE WHEN s.SPACE_STATUS_CODE = 'OCCUPIED' THEN active_usage.VEHICLE_NUMBER ELSE NULL END AS "vehicleNumber" FROM PARKING_SPACE s JOIN PARKING_ZONE z ON z.PARKING_ZONE_ID = s.PARKING_ZONE_ID JOIN PARKING_FLOOR f ON f.PARKING_FLOOR_ID = z.PARKING_FLOOR_ID LEFT JOIN ( /* 동일 구획에 미출차 사용기록이 2건 이상이면 번호를 잘못 표시하지 않습니다. */ SELECT PARKING_SPACE_ID, MAX(VEHICLE_NUMBER) AS VEHICLE_NUMBER FROM PARKING_USAGE WHERE EXIT_AT IS NULL AND PARKING_SPACE_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PARKING_SPACE_ID HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ) active_usage ON active_usage.PARKING_SPACE_ID = s.PARKING_SPACE_ID ORDER BY f.FLOOR_NO, z.ZONE_CODE, s.SPACE_NUMBER

SELECT s.PARKING_SPACE_ID AS "parkingSpaceId", s.SPACE_STATUS_CODE AS "spaceStatusCode", s.SPACE_TYPE_CODE AS "spaceTypeCode", s.MEMO AS "memo" FROM PARKING_SPACE s WHERE s.PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE PARKING_SPACE SET SPACE_STATUS_CODE = #{status}, SPACE_TYPE_CODE = #{type}, MEMO = #{memo}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{id}
UPDATE PARKING_SPACE_HISTORY SET VALID_TO = SYSDATE WHERE PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{id} AND VALID_TO IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARKING_SPACE_HISTORY ( PARKING_SPACE_HISTORY_ID, PARKING_SPACE_ID, PARKING_ZONE_ID, SPACE_NUMBER, SPACE_TYPE_CODE, SPACE_STATUS_CODE, X_POSITION, Y_POSITION, MEMO, CHANGED_BY_ADMIN_ID, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, CHANGE_SOURCE_CODE, CHANGE_REASON, AI_DETECTION_EVENT_ID ) SELECT SEQ_PARKING_SPACE_HISTORY.NEXTVAL, s.PARKING_SPACE_ID, s.PARKING_ZONE_ID, s.SPACE_NUMBER, s.SPACE_TYPE_CODE, s.SPACE_STATUS_CODE, s.X_POSITION, s.Y_POSITION, s.MEMO, #{adminId}, SYSDATE, NULL, 'ADMIN', #{reason}, NULL FROM PARKING_SPACE s WHERE s.PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT , s.MEMO AS "memo" FROM PARKING_SPACE s JOIN PARKING_ZONE z ON z.PARKING_ZONE_ID = s.PARKING_ZONE_ID JOIN PARKING_FLOOR f ON f.PARKING_FLOOR_ID = z.PARKING_FLOOR_ID WHERE s.PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{id}
